title: power
description: Shut down, restart, sign out or lock the device (Cihazlar / Sınıflar power actions, POST /api/devices/power). Sent only to an agent whose connection announced `power` in `X-Agent-Features`. For any other agent the server sends `shutdown` and `restart` as the old `execute` command instead (`shutdown /s|/r /f /t <max(delay,5)>`, on Windows with an optional `/c "<note>"` that keeps only letters, digits, spaces and . , : ; ? ' ( ) -; on Linux exactly that pattern, which the Linux agent maps to systemctl) and marks `logoff` and `lock` tasks `Denied` with exit code -8 without sending anything. Task rules as for `execute`: the server marks the task `Running` first and the same `task_id` may arrive again. The agent refuses when its local `power` capability is off (`result` with `exit_code` -5 and `capability_denied` with capability `power`); for `logoff` and `lock` with nobody signed in it answers `result` with `exit_code` -6 and output "[REDDEDİLDİ] oturum açık kullanıcı yok". Otherwise it shows a tray countdown of `delay` seconds with `message`, sends `result` with `exit_code` 0 and output starting "[TAMAM]" just before it acts, then acts. See docs/agent.md#power-and-user_message-contract.

op.description: shutdown = power off; restart = reboot; logoff = sign out the interactive user; lock = lock the interactive session. shutdown and restart are forced (unsaved work is lost).

delay.description: Seconds to wait before acting, with a tray countdown. 0 = act now (the agent may still show the note for a moment).

message.description: Optional note for the user, shown with the countdown; null when not set. Plain UTF-8 text on one line: the server has removed control characters, line breaks and bidirectional formatting characters. Display it as text, never pass it to a shell.

requested_by.description: Panel user (or API token) who asked for it; written to the device's local audit log, as for `execute`.
